scope: synthetic single-night rocket PvE parameter search; no GAN/neural training/PvP

spec.scope: synthetic single-night rocket PvE parameter search; no GAN/neural training/PvP
spec.replaySelection: first two holdout scenarios in listed order; captured during evaluation

assumptions.initialState: one base at 1500 HP; three level-2 rockets with adjacent stationary operators; three level-1 walls; synthetic positions, no construction/economy
assumptions.wave: 20 small + 12 middle + 3 large + 1 boss at night start; seeded unique positions
assumptions.robotSpeed: one adjacent cell per turn, greedy distance toward base; seed/id/round-dependent equal-distance tie-breaking to escape repeated collisions
assumptions.robotAttack: one attack OR move per turn; attacks any chosen defender within range 3, no line-of-sight test
assumptions.robotTarget: compare nearest-unit vs base-first priority; these are hypotheses
assumptions.movement: start-of-turn occupied cells blocked; same-target moves all canceled; vacated-cell chains unsupported
assumptions.damage: rocket hit positions read before robot movement; all damage applied at round end, lethally hit robots may still act
assumptions.cooldown: fire t, idle t+1/t+2/t+3, next fire t+4
assumptions.splash: 20 center, 10 eight-neighbor, repeated impacts stack; only robots damaged
assumptions.roles: fixed operators, may be hit or killed; no replacement/movement/revival within this night
assumptions.omitted: other weapons, player-versus-player attacks, mining, shops, upgrades, tasks, treasure, full-match scoring
